bitcoin_articles.headline: Reported Transfer of $443.88 Million in Crypto Assets to Coinbase Prime
bitcoin_articles.summary: Market reports indicate that approximately $443.88 million in Bitcoin and Ethereum was moved to Coinbase Prime.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Square Switches on Bitcoin Payments by Default for Eligible US Merchants
bitcoin_articles.summary: Square, a division of Block, Inc., has enabled Bitcoin payment acceptance by default for eligible US merchants.
